verdict.rationale: Sierra is an agent-building and management platform, so bulk operations across many items (such as mass-editing knowledge, journeys or conversations) is a fair axis, but the evidence pack documents no such capability. Explorer's natural-language analysis "across thousands of real conversations" is an adjacent read-only query feature, not a bulk action. Knowledge editing and Ghostwriter prompt-based updates are described only as single-item operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
